resource: undelivered WORLD_PRESENTATION batches in one session's egress
allocation_impact: With two batches undelivered, the next batch is dropped whole and consumes no revision; presentation never fills the egress queue and never trips FND-02 §16 slow-client handling. While a snapshot of any domain is in flight for the session, its events are dropped, not retained behind the barrier.
boundary_tests: max=2: a session with one undelivered batch is sent the next (emitting connection test, SPELL-PRESENT-1 or COMBAT-PRESENT-1)
max+1=3: with two undelivered the third is dropped whole, no revision is consumed and no resync follows (same test)
consumers: SPELL-PRESENT-1 or COMBAT-PRESENT-1 presentation egress (not yet composed)
